domain_label: Frosting, Filling & Finishing - Assembly, Filling, Texture Contrast & Decoration
assumptions: no observed dataset or benchmark evidence supplied; all scores are heuristic priors grounded in standard pastry references
a single cupcake practitioner aims to maximize deliciousness within food-safety limits
exclusions: cake batter formulation and baking chemistry
frosting flavor recipe development beyond ratio and consistency

competency_questions.question: How is a filling cavity created without compromising crumb structure?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: CORE_METHOD defines coring sized to wall strength

competency_questions.question: How is the frosting-to-cake ratio set for a balanced bite?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RATIO_BALANCE specifies frosting weight per cupcake

competency_questions.question: How is frosting consistency and piping technique chosen for a clean crown?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PIPE_CONSISTENCY and PIPE_TECHNIQUE define stiffness and motion

competency_questions.question: How is moisture migration from filling to crumb prevented?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: MOISTURE_BARRIER and SYRUP_SOAK manage the moisture gradient

competency_questions.question: Which filling type fits the flavor and structural goal?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FILL_CURD, FILL_JAM, FILL_GANACHE cover the filling choices

competency_questions.question: How are cake and frosting sweetness coordinated to preserve flavor complexity?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: RATIO_SWEETNESS sets a combined sweetness budget that protects non-sugar flavors

competency_questions.question: How is swirl definition kept without slumping or tearing?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: PIPE_CONSISTENCY tunes stiffness to the display window

competency_questions.question: How is added moisture controlled for both flavor and shelf life?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SYRUP_SOAK and SHELFLIFE bound moisture and staling

competency_questions.question: How are texture and temperature contrast engineered into the bite?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: TEXTURE_CONTRAST and TEMP_CONTRAST plan the contrast

competency_questions.question: How are perishable fillings made and held safely?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: FOOD_SAFETY and FILL_CURD enforce safe cooking and holding

competency_questions.question: How are garnish and inclusions selected and placed?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: GARNISH_SELECT, INCLUSION_MIX, and VISUAL_FINISH define the decoration

competency_questions.question: How is fresh texture preserved against assemble-ahead convenience?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: SHELFLIFE and TEXTURE_CONTRAST set assembly timing

competency_questions.question: How does the visual finish drive appeal without hurting taste?
In what order are the cupcakes assembled to succeed safely?
competency_questions.acceptance_condition: ASSEMBLY_SEQUENCE and FOOD_SAFETY define ordered just-in-time steps

glossary.definition: removing a central plug or cone from a baked cupcake to create a filling cavity
a cooked, set filling thickened by egg coagulation and acid, e.g. lemon curd
an emulsion of chocolate and cream whose set firmness is tuned by ratio
the mass or volume balance of frosting to cake per cupcake that governs balance of bite
a flavored sugar syrup brushed onto cake to add moisture and flavor
a seal placed between wet filling and crumb to limit water migration
the stiffness of frosting that lets a piped form hold its edge without slumping or tearing
a silky, less-sweet buttercream built on cooked meringue
deliberate variation of crisp, soft, and yielding textures across a bite
the temperature range in which perishable foods grow pathogens unsafely
a solid bit folded into frosting or crumb for texture, sized to pass the tip
the composed final appearance of the cupcake that drives appetite appeal

source_registry.description: heuristic prior estimates for cupcake assembly, filling, and decoration work units grounded in standard pastry references in absence of supplied datasets
source_registry.citation_or_locator: Beranbaum The Cake Bible; Friberg The Professional Pastry Chef; CIA Baking and Pastry; Parks BraveTart

nodes.definition: Choose a coring method (cone cut, apple-corer plug, piping-tip injection) sized to crumb structure so a filling cavity is created without collapsing the cupcake.

included: crumb that can hold a cavity

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Creates a flavor surprise center and texture contrast in the bite
pros.example: apple-corer plug holds a tablespoon of curd

cons.claim: Over-coring a tender crumb collapses the wall and the cupcake structurally fails
cons.example: deep injection in a fragile chiffon tears the side

failure_modes: cavity too small to taste filling
acceptance_tests: cavity holds target filling volume without wall breach
revisit_triggers: new crumb formula changes wall strength

nodes.definition: Set a fruit curd or custard filling to a pipeable, slice-stable consistency (cook to starch/egg coagulation, chill) so it tastes bright but does not weep into the crumb.

included: cook temperature for safe egg coagulation

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Acidic curd cuts frosting sweetness and adds bright contrast
pros.example: lemon curd against vanilla buttercream

cons.claim: Undercooked egg curd is a food-safety hazard in the danger zone
cons.example: curd held warm overnight grows pathogens

failure_modes: egg not cooked to safe coagulation
acceptance_tests: set curd holds shape in cavity at serving temp

nodes.definition: Reduce a jam or fruit preserve to a low-water, high-pectin consistency so the filling adds concentrated flavor without migrating moisture into the crumb.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Concentrated jam delivers fruit flavor without thinning into the crumb
pros.example: raspberry jam reduced to a thick set

cons.claim: Under-reduced jam is too wet and saturates the surrounding cake
cons.example: loose jam soaks and gums the crumb

acceptance_tests: jam brix high enough to resist crumb migration
filling tastes of fruit not just sugar

nodes.definition: Emulsify a ganache center at a chocolate:cream ratio tuned to set firm-but-yielding at serving temperature so the molten-feeling core contrasts the cake.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A soft ganache core reads as luxurious and contrasts a fluffier crumb
pros.example: 2:1 dark ganache stays yielding at room temp

cons.claim: Broken emulsion makes a greasy, grainy core
cons.example: cold cream shocks the emulsion and it splits

failure_modes: sets too hard from cold service
acceptance_tests: core yields at intended serving temperature

nodes.definition: Set the frosting-to-cake mass ratio and crown height so each bite carries balanced cake-to-frosting and neither overwhelms the other.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A measured ratio keeps the cupcake from being cloying or dry
pros.example: 45g cake to 25g frosting reads balanced

cons.claim: Too much sweet frosting buries the cake flavor and fatigues the palate
cons.example: a towering swirl doubles perceived sweetness

acceptance_tests: frosting weight per cupcake is specified and repeatable

nodes.definition: Coordinate cake sweetness against frosting sweetness so total perceived sweetness lands in a target window and flavor complexity survives.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Pairing a less-sweet cake with sweet frosting keeps total sweetness in balance
pros.example: Swiss meringue lets a sweeter cake shine

cons.claim: Sweet cake plus sweet frosting compounds into one-note candy
cons.example: both at full sugar mask the vanilla and salt

acceptance_tests: combined tasting lands within target sweetness window

nodes.definition: Select and stabilize a buttercream type (American, Swiss/Italian meringue, French) for the target sweetness, structure, and pipe-hold.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Meringue buttercreams are silkier and less sweet than American
pros.example: Italian meringue buttercream pipes clean and tastes balanced

cons.claim: Wrong type for the climate or sweetness target undermines balance and hold
cons.example: American buttercream is too sweet for an already-sweet cake

nodes.definition: Tune frosting consistency (stiffness via temperature, fat ratio, hydration) to the piped form so swirls hold edge definition without tearing or slumping.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Correct stiffness gives crisp swirl ridges that read as professional
pros.example: a stiff-but-pliable buttercream holds a tall rose

cons.claim: Too warm and the swirl slumps; too cold and it tears the surface
cons.example: over-warm frosting melts into a puddle on display

acceptance_tests: test pipe holds defined ridge for the display window

nodes.definition: Execute the piping motion (tip selection, angle, pressure, speed) to deposit a consistent, repeatable swirl or rosette across a batch.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Consistent motion yields uniform crowns that signal quality
pros.example: even pressure makes every swirl the same height

cons.claim: Inconsistent pressure makes a ragged, uneven batch
cons.example: speeding up mid-swirl leaves thin tails

acceptance_tests: batch swirls are visually uniform within tolerance

nodes.definition: Apply a soaking syrup at a controlled volume to add moisture and flavor without saturating the crumb to sogginess.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A light syrup soak revives a leaner crumb and adds flavor
pros.example: a citrus syrup brightens a sponge

cons.claim: Over-soaking dissolves crumb structure into a wet, gummy mass
cons.example: too much syrup makes the cupcake fall apart

nodes.definition: Place a moisture barrier (chocolate seal, sealed crumb, jam glaze) between wet filling and dry crumb so water does not migrate and gum the cake over time.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A thin chocolate seal keeps a wet filling from soaking the crumb over a day
pros.example: melted chocolate brushed in the cavity holds curd dry-side

cons.claim: Without a barrier high-water fillings gum the crumb within hours
cons.example: fresh fruit filling wets the cake by service

acceptance_tests: barrier coverage is continuous over the interface
crumb stays intact over the hold window

nodes.definition: Engineer textural contrast across the bite (crisp garnish, soft frosting, tender crumb, yielding core) so the cupcake is dynamic rather than monotone.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Crunch against soft frosting makes each bite more interesting
pros.example: a praline shard on silky buttercream

cons.claim: A crisp element added too early goes soft and the contrast is lost
cons.example: streusel placed an hour ahead absorbs moisture

acceptance_tests: assembly delivers at least two distinct textures at serving time

nodes.definition: Plan serving temperature and any temperature contrast (warm core, chilled frosting) so fats read correctly and contrast is intentional.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Serving near room temperature lets buttercream fat melt on the palate
pros.example: cold-from-fridge buttercream tastes waxy and flat

cons.claim: Serving outside the safe holding window for dairy/egg components is a hazard
cons.example: custard-filled cupcakes left warm too long

failure_modes: frosting served too cold tastes waxy
components held in the danger zone
acceptance_tests: perishable components kept within safe holding window

nodes.definition: Select garnishes and inclusions that reinforce the flavor story and add texture, sized and placed to stay stable until service.
outputs: selected garnish set with placement plan

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A garnish that echoes the filling tells the eater what to expect
pros.example: a candied lemon slice over lemon-curd filling

cons.claim: A garnish chosen only for looks can clash or introduce an allergen
cons.example: a nut garnish on a nut-free brand promise

failure_modes: garnish wilts or melts before service
acceptance_tests: garnish stable through the hold window

nodes.definition: Fold inclusions (chips, crunch, fruit bits) into frosting or crumb at a size and load that adds interest without blocking the piping tip or weighing the crumb.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Small crunchy inclusions add texture throughout the swirl
pros.example: fine cookie crumb folded into buttercream

cons.claim: Inclusions larger than the tip bore jam the bag mid-pipe
cons.example: whole chips clog a small star tip

failure_modes: inclusions sink or weigh the crumb
acceptance_tests: inclusion size passes the chosen tip bore cleanly

nodes.definition: Compose the final visual (swirl form, color, height, negative space, garnish placement) so the cupcake reads appetizing and on-brand before the first bite.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: First impression is visual; an appetizing finish drives the sale and sets expectation
pros.example: a clean tall swirl with one deliberate garnish

cons.claim: Over-decorating muddies the look and can signal lower quality
cons.example: too many clashing toppings look cluttered

acceptance_tests: finished cupcake matches the intended style reference

nodes.definition: Manage frosting color (natural vs added colorants, intensity, stability under light) so appearance supports appetite appeal without off-flavors.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Appropriate color signals the flavor and looks fresh
pros.example: a pale natural strawberry tint reads real

cons.claim: Heavy artificial color can add bitterness and look synthetic
cons.example: too much gel dye tastes bitter and stains

acceptance_tests: color matches flavor cue without detectable off-flavor

nodes.definition: Enforce food-safety controls across assembly (egg/dairy cooking, danger-zone time/temperature, allergen separation) as a hard gate over any flavor or texture choice.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Safe handling prevents foodborne illness regardless of how good it tastes
pros.example: custard filling cooked and chilled, held cold

cons.claim: A delicious unsafe cupcake can cause illness and is never acceptable
cons.example: raw-egg filling held warm risks salmonella

acceptance_tests: egg/dairy components cooked or held to safe spec

nodes.definition: Plan assembly timing and storage so fresh texture (crisp garnish, soft crumb) is preserved to the point of consumption against shelf-life decay.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: Adding crisp garnish at the last moment preserves the contrast
pros.example: streusel applied at service stays crunchy

cons.claim: Assembling too far ahead trades fresh texture for convenience
cons.example: day-ahead assembly leaves garnish soft and crumb stale

failure_modes: assembly outpaces sales and waste rises
acceptance_tests: assembly timing keeps key textures fresh to sale
storage limits staling within the window

nodes.definition: Coordinate crumb tenderness and dome shape so the cupcake top accepts a frosting crown and the wall holds a filling cavity.
outputs: crumb spec suited to fill-and-frost assembly

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A gently domed, tender-but-cohesive crumb both pipes and cores well
pros.example: a slightly flat top seats a swirl cleanly

cons.claim: Maximum tenderness can mean walls too weak to hold a cavity
cons.example: an ultra-tender crumb tears when cored

failure_modes: dome too peaked to pipe on
acceptance_tests: top geometry accepts a centered crown
wall holds a cavity without breach

nodes.definition: Define the assembly order and just-in-time sequencing (cool, core, fill, barrier, frost, garnish) so each step succeeds and freshness is preserved.

probabilistic_layer.update_signal: taste-panel or texture/structure feedback revises priors

pros.claim: A correct sequence prevents melted frosting and soggy garnish
pros.example: frost only after cupcakes are fully cooled

cons.claim: Wrong order ruins otherwise good components
cons.example: garnishing before frosting leaves toppings unanchored

failure_modes: frosting melts on a warm cupcake
acceptance_tests: assembly steps run in a validated order

edges.why_related: a cavity must exist before curd is filled in
cavity precedes jam filling
cavity precedes ganache center
wall strength governs how the cupcake can be cored
sweetness coordination sets the mass-ratio target
edges.risk_of_conflict: ratio set before sweetness is wrong
edges.example: less-sweet cake allows a bigger crown

edges.why_related: sweetness budget drives buttercream type choice
edges.risk_of_conflict: sweet frosting chosen against a sweet cake
edges.example: meringue buttercream for a sweeter cake

edges.why_related: the chosen buttercream determines achievable consistency
edges.benefit_of_coupling: consistency tuned to the frosting system
edges.risk_of_conflict: tuning a frosting that cannot hold

edges.why_related: motion depends on correct consistency
edges.risk_of_conflict: good motion wasted on slumping frosting

edges.why_related: wet curd requires a barrier decision
edges.benefit_of_coupling: barrier sized to filling water activity
edges.risk_of_conflict: wet curd gums crumb without a barrier

edges.why_related: jam water content drives barrier need
frosting amount shapes texture layering
the piped form is one texture layer
edges.benefit_of_coupling: soft swirl set against crisp garnish

edges.why_related: the swirl is the core of the visual
garnish completes the visual composition
ganache set point depends on serving temperature
buttercream mouthfeel depends on serving temperature
edges.benefit_of_coupling: fat melts properly at service temp

edges.why_related: color is applied to the chosen frosting base
edges.risk_of_conflict: color added before base is set

edges.why_related: garnish supplies a key contrast texture
inclusions must pass the consistency and tip
edges.example: fine crumb through a star tip

edges.why_related: barrier integrity drives how long crumb stays intact
crisp textures decay over the hold window
coring is an ordered assembly step
frosting is a sequenced step
garnish timing is sequenced
safety controls gate the assembly flow
syrup adds moisture that softens the crumb structure
syrup raises crumb moisture, constraining barrier needs
inclusions and finish both shape perceived texture and look
color directly drives appetite appeal
staling degrades the finished appearance over time
safe holding limits the temperature-contrast options
edges.risk_of_conflict: warm core held too long is unsafe

edges.why_related: more filling cavity competes with crumb structural integrity
edges.example: big curd center vs tender crumb
edges.resolution_rule: crumb structural integrity dominates; cap filling volume to what the wall holds

edges.why_related: a bigger frosting crown raises total sweetness
edges.benefit_of_coupling: measured crown keeps sweetness in window
edges.resolution_rule: sweetness budget dominates; reduce crown or lower frosting sugar

edges.why_related: assembling ahead for convenience sacrifices fresh crisp texture
edges.resolution_rule: fresh texture dominates for premium; garnish at service, assemble base ahead

edges.why_related: raw-egg richness conflicts with safe cooking and holding
edges.risk_of_conflict: raw or warm-held curd is unsafe
edges.resolution_rule: food safety dominates absolutely; cook egg to safe temp and hold cold

edges.why_related: a showy tall swirl can push sweetness past balance
edges.benefit_of_coupling: modest swirl balances look and taste
edges.resolution_rule: taste balance dominates; achieve visual impact with form and garnish not extra sweet mass

conflict_axes.trigger: larger filling cavities weaken the crumb wall
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if walls breach, structure dominates and cavity shrinks

conflict_axes.trigger: added moisture improves bite but can dissolve crumb structure
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if crumb gums, structure dominates and moisture is reduced
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: crumb integrity score drops below spec

conflict_axes.trigger: raising sugar can mask acid and aromatic flavor notes
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if flavors are masked, complexity side caps sugar

conflict_axes.trigger: both components sweet compound past the target window
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if combined exceeds window, the larger sugar source is cut

conflict_axes.trigger: assembling far ahead is faster but degrades texture and finish
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if finish degrades, quality dominates and finishing moves later

conflict_axes.trigger: crisp fresh elements have a short hold window
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if texture decays in the window, freshness side reschedules
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: crisp garnish soft within hold window

conflict_axes.trigger: a very tender, high-domed crumb is hard to core and to frost flat
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if assembly fails, geometry side adjusts the crumb
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: cored wall tears or dome rejects swirl

conflict_axes.trigger: showy decoration can add sweet mass or off-flavor that hurts taste
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: if taste suffers, balance side trims decoration mass
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: oversized crown or heavy dye for looks

conflict_axes.trigger: raw or warm-held perishable fillings taste rich but are unsafe
conflict_axes.dominance_logic: food safety always dominates; unsafe options are rejected outright
conflict_axes.escalation_threshold: perishable held in the danger zone

under-set curd weeps into the crumb
edge_cases.failure_mode: wet gummy crumb around the cavity

nut garnish on a declared nut-free line

edge_cases.trigger: too much syrup saturates the crumb

crisp garnish applied too early softens
heavy gel color bleeds or fades under display light
edge_cases.example: bright dye fades on the shelf

edge_cases.trigger: piping inconsistency drifts frosting weight off target

workflow.do_first_because: all assembly depends on a fill-and-frost-ready crumb

workflow.objective: select and safely prepare the filling
workflow.do_first_because: unsafe or wet filling poisons everything downstream

workflow.objective: control moisture between filling and crumb
workflow.do_first_because: moisture migration ruins texture over the hold window

workflow.objective: coordinate sweetness and set frosting-to-cake ratio
workflow.do_first_because: ratio and sweetness anchor balance of bite

workflow.objective: select and stabilize the frosting and color
workflow.do_first_because: the frosting system constrains consistency and look

workflow.objective: tune consistency and pipe a uniform crown
workflow.do_first_because: piping realizes the ratio and visual plan

workflow.objective: plan and verify contrast in the bite
select garnish and compose the final look
workflow.do_first_because: the finish drives appeal and sets expectation

workflow.objective: enforce safety and set assembly timing
workflow.do_first_because: safety gates production and shelf life governs freshness

workflow.objective: run the validated just-in-time assembly sequence
workflow.do_first_because: orchestration ties every step into a delivered cupcake

dominance_rules.trigger: perishable component conflicts with flavor or texture goal
dominance_rules.rule: food safety overrides all flavor and texture choices
dominance_rules.required_action: cook or hold to safe spec or remove the component
dominance_rules.example: raw-egg curd held warm is rejected

dominance_rules.trigger: structural integrity conflicts with filling volume or moisture
dominance_rules.rule: crumb structure dominates once a breach or gumming threshold is hit
dominance_rules.required_action: cap cavity and meter syrup; add a barrier
dominance_rules.example: over-filled center that collapses is reduced

dominance_rules.trigger: combined sweetness conflicts with flavor complexity
dominance_rules.rule: flavor complexity dominates past the sweetness window
dominance_rules.required_action: cut the larger sugar source and add acid
dominance_rules.example: sweet cake plus sweet frosting is rebalanced

dominance_rules.trigger: visual impact conflicts with taste balance
dominance_rules.rule: taste balance dominates over decorative sweet mass or dye
dominance_rules.required_action: achieve impact with form and garnish not sugar or color
dominance_rules.example: oversized crown for looks is trimmed

dominance_rules.trigger: convenience conflicts with fresh-texture quality for premium product
dominance_rules.rule: fresh texture dominates for premium; finish to order
dominance_rules.example: crisp garnish is applied at service not ahead

dominance_rules.trigger: serving temperature conflicts with safe holding
dominance_rules.rule: safe holding dominates any temperature-contrast ambition
dominance_rules.required_action: keep perishables within the safe window
dominance_rules.example: warm custard core is not held warm too long

dominance_rules.trigger: piping aesthetics conflict with frosting-to-cake ratio
dominance_rules.rule: the ratio target dominates over piped volume
dominance_rules.required_action: weigh-calibrate piping to the ratio spec
dominance_rules.example: heavy swirls overshooting weight are re-piped

dominance_rules.trigger: inclusion size conflicts with piping reliability
dominance_rules.required_action: size inclusions below the tip bore
dominance_rules.example: chips ground to pass the tip

anti_rework_rules.rule: confirm a fill-and-frost-ready crumb before any filling or frosting work
anti_rework_rules.rationale: all assembly depends on crumb geometry
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: coring a crumb that cannot hold a cavity
anti_rework_rules.example: building fillings before crumb is validated

anti_rework_rules.rule: cook and chill perishable fillings to safe spec before assembling
anti_rework_rules.rationale: safety cannot be retrofitted after assembly
anti_rework_rules.example: filling warm cupcakes with raw curd

anti_rework_rules.rule: fix the sweetness budget and ratio before choosing frosting type
anti_rework_rules.rationale: frosting choice depends on the sweetness plan
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: picking a sweet frosting against a sweet cake

anti_rework_rules.rule: decide the moisture barrier before filling wet centers
anti_rework_rules.rationale: barriers must be in place before wet contact
anti_rework_rules.violation_signal: sealing after the crumb already gummed
anti_rework_rules.example: filling wet curd with no barrier plan

anti_rework_rules.rule: tune consistency before practicing the piping motion
anti_rework_rules.rationale: motion is wasted on the wrong consistency

anti_rework_rules.rule: size inclusions to the tip bore before loading the bag
anti_rework_rules.rationale: oversized inclusions stall the whole batch
anti_rework_rules.example: loading whole chips into a small tip

anti_rework_rules.rule: set serving temperature and safe holding before planning temperature contrast
anti_rework_rules.example: planning a warm core with no holding limit

anti_rework_rules.rule: sequence garnish to service time before committing to a crisp garnish
anti_rework_rules.example: applying crisp garnish a day ahead

iteration_protocol.detection: panel scores sweetness or balance out of target

iteration_protocol.trigger: swirl slump or tear on the display line

iteration_protocol.detection: texture check fails at service time

version_increment_rules: increment on any hard-locked artifact change
lock_downgrade_rules: downgrade soft_lock to draft on upstream dependency change
